qt: to the Commission Stefano Cavedagna (ECR), Carlo Fidanza (ECR), Lara Magoni (ECR), Mariateresa Vivaldini (ECR), Nicola Procaccini (ECR), Pietro Fiocchi (ECR), Alberico Gambino (ECR), Daniele Polato (ECR), Sergio Berlato (ECR), Ruggero Razza (ECR), Elena Donazzan (ECR), Alessandro Ciriani (ECR), Paolo Inselvini (ECR), Francesco Torselli (ECR) Subject:

The ESA was held in Strasbourg on 3-4 March 2022 as part of the Conference on the Future of Europe and involved students from several European universities. As reported in newspaper Il Giornale, the participants apparently included Youssef Siher – named on the website of the 4EU+ association as a delegate of the University of Milan – to draw up recommendations on the future of Europe to be sent to the Commission and the European Parliament. Given the recent reports of his implication in an investigation into alleged terrorism-related offences in Italy, Mr Siher’s participation raises questions. We therefore ask the Commission: 1.

Whether the European Student Assembly and Mr Youssef Siher receive funding or reimbursement for participating in the initiative, and if so, what were the programmes and amounts and who were the beneficiaries?

What was the relevance of this form of interaction between the European Commission, its agencies and Mr Siher, and what were the content and purpose of the debates and decision-making processes at European level?

In which selection procedures did he participate, and on what basis? Are there forms of oversight, verification or selection by the Commission and its agencies in order to verify the appropriateness of those participating in these programmes? If so, will the Commission list them, or, if not, explain why?
